title: A failed run exits 0 with state 'done' from ticfac watch / ticfac run / run --cloud
description:
watch.go:386-403 finishes as done on any run_finished not preceded by run_held, and holdsForAPerson excludes gate failures, merge conflicts and CI failures; run.go:506 maps 0 to done. Reproduced: feed run_finished 'failed: the integrated gate refused ...' then watch --json exits 0 with schema ticfac.watch.v1 state=done; the TTY path also exits 0. Failed and done are not distinguishable by exit code, which A4 requires.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding b2e34be7e52f89febb5c8ae9888591122c3363c5b296664fe197e0e93ac5aca6 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-xbp/attempt-32): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A4. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/b2e34be7e52f89febb5c8ae9888591122c3363c5b296664fe197e0e93ac5aca6.json on the run branch.
